instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a small artist studio with a central studio, office, store, pantry, WC, and a light roof profile. The tenant needs a ventilated finishing booth near the store for material work, but the main studio volume and roof silhouette should remain intact. Add the finishing booth, its access door, and a high ventilation window record so the handover model describes the safer workflow.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
